description: Use this when someone sends a document for an application: 'here is my passport', 'هذا جواز سفري', 'вот мой паспорт', 'यह रहा मेरा पासपोर्ट'. Uploads one file to an application through the questionnaire's own pipeline: the file the person attached in this chat, in file (at most 10 MB); its bytes in file_base64 (at most 3 MB), the staged_path of a file put into storage through visarun_create_upload_link, or the upload_page_id of a page the person uploaded it on (visarun_create_upload_page). A file that lands in a field is then read in the background, usually for under a minute (OCR, forensics, the passport-photo face check); the upload changes no answer. Call visarun_get_application_fields once it is read: documents.items[].files[].read.answers holds what it read, in the keys visarun_save_answers takes; check them with the person and save the ones they accept. document_type and field_key from the fields call (documents.items[]). A passport, ID card or residence permit put over another is compared with it first, about a minute: another person's document or a worse scan leaves the previous one in the field (replacement_kept_previous, with what differs); replace: keep_new puts the new one in anyway. If the call ends before its answer, visarun_get_application_fields shows which file the field holds (documents.items[].files). A passport PDF put in the passport field also fills the empty page fields with its pages, the cover and, for an Indian passport or one whose nationality is not known yet, the last page (another passport's last page is optional and stays empty): the answer's pages names each (filled; kept or taken when it holds another file, maybe an older passport's page; failed when it got none), and the fields call shows the page each one uses (files[].page).

file.description: The file the person attached in this chat

file_base64.description: The file bytes, base64; or staged_path

file_name.description: The file's name; not needed with upload_page_id

replace.description: keep_new: skip the comparison with the document held

staged_path.description: From visarun_create_upload_link, once the file is PUT there

upload_page_id.description: From visarun_create_upload_page, once the person says the file is uploaded, with the document_type and field_key the page was made for

name: visarun_upload_document
title: Upload document
